title: Principal Data Scientist
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

As Principal Data Scientist, this leader will manage and guide a team (or significant workstream) within the Payment Integrity Decision Intelligence (PIDI) Data Science and AIML Analytics India organization. The role focuses on executing data science and AI-led initiatives, delivering analytical excellence, and generating measurable business value across clinical and non-clinical payment integrity programs through a high-performing team of data scientists and AIML professionals.

The leader will foster a culture of innovation, scientific rigor, and continuous improvement while implementing best practices for model development, validation, monitoring, and performance optimization. They will collaborate closely with the Director and global analytics and data science teams.

Responsible for advancing PIDI analytical capabilities by leading the development, refinement, and deployment of predictive and prescriptive models that uncover actionable opportunities and drive measurable business outcomes, aligned with the broader team strategy.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Lead and manage a team of Data Scientists and AIML experts (or a major portfolio of initiatives), providing day-to-day direction, mentoring, coaching, and performance management to deliver AI, Machine Learning, and Advanced Analytics solutions that support payment integrity outcomes and business value
* Contribute to team vision, priorities, and execution roadmaps in partnership with the Director; translate strategic objectives into actionable plans and ensure on-time, high-quality delivery of scalable analytical solutions
* Partner with business, operations, clinical, product, and technology stakeholders to identify high-value opportunities, influence solution design, and drive adoption of data science and AIML outputs across clinical and non-clinical value streams
* Drive and contribute hands-on to the end-to-end AIML lifecycle for assigned areas, including problem formulation, data exploration, feature engineering, model development, validation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Focus areas include detection of Fraud, Waste, Abuse and Error (FWAE), outliers or aberrant billing patterns, overpayments, gaps, and leakage opportunities
* Implement and strengthen model performance, governance, and value-realization practices within the team's scope, including success metrics, monitoring strategies, financial impact assessment, model validation, and optimization to maximize sustainable savings and outcomes
* Champion and apply advanced analytics and AI methodologies-including machine learning, deep learning, predictive and prescriptive analytics, anomaly detection, simulation, and statistical modeling-to solve complex healthcare and payment integrity challenges
* Support applied research, innovation, and modernization efforts by evaluating emerging fraud and abuse patterns, next-generation AI techniques, and analytical approaches, and by helping translate experimentation into production-ready solutions that improve detection accuracy and operational efficiency
* Uphold and operationalize Responsible AI practices, including data compliance, AIRB processes, model risk management, explainability, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop oversight, ensuring safe, ethical, and business-aligned deployment of AIML solutions
* Stay current with advancements in Data Science, AIML, Healthcare Analytics, and Payment Integrity, and actively share knowledge to elevate team capabilities and contribute to organizational innovation
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Graduate (Master's/PhD preferred) degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative discipline
* 12+ years of experience in Data Science, Advanced Analytics, AIML, and predictive modeling, with at least 6-8+ years leading teams, projects, or significant workstreams (people leadership experience strongly preferred)
* 8+ years of hands-on programming experience using Python, R, SAS, SQL, and distributed computing frameworks, including statistical and research-oriented analysis of diverse data types to build or optimize predictive methods
* Solid hands-on experience applying machine learning in healthcare or other high-stakes domains (direct experience in a cloud environment is highly valued)
* Solid expertise in Machine Learning, Statistical Modeling, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and familiarity with Generative AI technologies
* Experience designing and delivering AIML solutions from concept through production deployment and business adoption
* Experience with cloud-based AIML platforms such as Azure AI, Azure Databricks, or equivalent
* Working knowledge of MLOps, Model Governance, Responsible AI, Model Monitoring, AI Risk Management, and AIRB frameworks
* Demonstrated ability to partner with senior stakeholders and business leaders to translate complex problems into practical, scalable AI solutions
* Demonstrated solid communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills with the ability to influence decisions and drive alignment

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, Copilot, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI automation, and ML engineering tools/frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain, or LangGraph
* Experience deploying machine learning models at scale with CI/CD, automated monitoring, observability, and model lifecycle management
* Experience supporting AI-driven product development, innovation programs, or research-to-production initiatives
* Exposure to AIML system design, solution architecture, enterprise integration patterns, APIs, and microservices-based deployments
* Knowledge of data platforms and big data technologies including Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric, or Hadoop ecosystems
* Familiarity with Lean Six Sigma (Green Belt/Kaizen) or similar continuous improvement methodologies

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Data Scientist II
description:
Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments - creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.

  
  

**Job Overview**  
Do you enjoy building modern Analytics, AI, and Generative AI solutions using cutting-edge cloud technologies? Are you  
passionate about developing intelligent applications, AI agents, enterprise integrations, and scalable cloud-native  
services?  
Conduent is seeking an AI Solutions Engineer with strong software engineering, cloud development, and Generative AI  
expertise to join our Analytics & Data Science Practice. This role is responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and  
supporting enterprise Analytics, AI, and GenAI solutions leveraging Azure AI services and modern cloud-native  
technologies. The engineer will work closely with Senior Engineers, Technical Leads, Data Scientists, and Architects to  
build reusable platform capabilities and deliver innovative solutions across multiple business domains.  
The role combines hands-on software engineering, AI application development, cloud deployment, and DevOps practices  
to create secure, scalable, and production-ready AI solutions. Success in this role is measured by the ability to rapidly  
develop, deploy, and operationalize high-quality Analytics and AI solutions while contributing reusable capabilities that  
accelerate future delivery.

**Responsibilities:**

* Develop, test, and deploy Analytics, AI, and Generative AI solutions using Azure AI services and modern

application development frameworks.

* Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, AI assistants, AI agents, knowledge retrieval systems,

and intelligent business applications.

* Implement prompt engineering, prompt orchestration, and grounding

* Develop AI agents, agent workflows, & multi-step reasoning processes to automate tasks and user interactions.

* Implement tool integrations, workflow orchestration, and human-in-the-loop capabilities.

* Design and develop APIs, microservices, integrations, and cloud-native services.

* Deploy, configure, and support solutions across Azure cloud environments.

* Develop and maintain infrastructure, application configurations, & deployment assets supporting solution delivery.

* Perform unit testing, integration testing, debugging, and performance optimization.

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines supporting automated testing and deployment.

* Work with Azure services including App Services, Azure Functions, Container Apps, Storage, Key Vault, API

Management, and related platform components.

* Support production deployments, release validation, and operational readiness activities.

* Follow established development standards, architecture guidelines, DevOps practices, and coding standards.

* Participate in code reviews, design reviews and contribute to technical documentation, implementation guides,

deployment procedures, and operational runbooks.

* Participate in Agile planning, sprint execution, estimation, and delivery activities.

* Stay current with advances in AI, GenAI, cloud technologies, and software engineering practices.

Experience Needed:

* 5-8 years of experience in software engineering, cloud engineering, analytics, AI, data engineering, or application

development.

* 3+ years experience developing and delivering cloud-native applications and services. Hands-on Azure experience

is required.

* Experience delivering enterprise solutions using modern software development practices.

* Experience working within Agile and cross-functional delivery teams.

* Hands-on expertise to develop and deploy applications on Azure, including services such as App Service, Azure

Functions, Container Apps, Azure AI Foundry, AKS, Storage, Key Vault, API Management, or similar components

* Hands-on experience delivering GenAI solutions into production environments including prompt and RAG (retrieval[1]augmented generation) patterns, responsible AI controls & guardrails, AI orchestration.

* Strong Python development skills.

* Experience building REST APIs, microservices and implementing cloud-native applications.

* Strong understanding of software architecture principles and design patterns.

* Experience building containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes technologies.

* Familiarity with front-end application development and modern application frameworks.

* Experience with: CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure-as-Code, Test automation, Monitoring and observability,

Production support processes, Root cause analysis and Performance optimization

* BS or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.

Additional Requirements

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Ability to work directly with technical and business stakeholders.

* Experience supporting global onshore/offshore delivery models.

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

* Ability to balance hands-on development responsibilities with technical leadership responsibilities.

* Passion for emerging Analytics, AI, and GenAI technologies

title: Senior Manager- AI Strategy & Solutions
description:
**About Our Company**

Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year-end 2024. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.

Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**

Integral role in supporting AIM’s data analysis, system control, and database needs. Provide strategic ideas and thought leadership. Has/can apply solid financial industry data systems knowledge to support decision and strategy problems in key business areas. Demonstrates strong technical/problem solving skills. Manages multiple projects collaboratively. Works with HR in recruitment and performance appraisal process. Mentor the team members and layout their growth path.

**Role Summary**

Leads the execution and operationalization of enterprise AI initiatives, ensuring AI strategy is translated into scalable, business-impacting solutions. Partners across business and technology teams to drive delivery, adoption, and measurable outcomes, while maintaining strong alignment to enterprise priorities and governance. Acts as a senior program leader with end-to-end accountability for execution, value realization, and executive alignment across priority AI initiatives

**Key Responsibilities**

**1) Enterprise AI Execution & Operationalization:** Translate enterprise AI strategy into actionable roadmaps, delivery plans, and implementation milestones**.** Drive end-to-end execution of priority AI initiatives across multiple business areas. Ensure AI solutions move from concept to pilot to scaled deployment, and ultimately to sustained adoption. Own delivery outcomes across initiatives, including scope, timelines, and measurable business impact.

**2) Program & Portfolio Delivery:** Lead a portfolio of AI use cases and programs across the enterprise. Establish and manage delivery discipline (prioritization, dependencies, timelines, risk mitigation). Ensure outcomes are tied to clear business value (e.g., productivity, growth, cost, risk). Drive integrated program plans, track KPIs and milestones, and proactively manage risks, dependencies, and execution challenges, escalating as needed.

**3) Cross-Enterprise Partnership** Partner with Business leaders across functions, Technology, Data & Analytics team, and Risk, Legal, and Governance teams.Align stakeholders around what gets delivered and how, while shaping execution priorities and ensuring alignment to enterprise AI strategy. Engage senior leaders, including ELT stakeholders, to drive alignment, inform decision-making, and ensure transparency on progress, risks, and outcomes. Act as a clear point of accountability for progress and results.

**4) Technical & Solution Leadership:** Provide informed direction on AI/ML and GenAI solutions to ensure fit-for-purpose design.Bridge strategy and execution by helping teams define use cases, select appropriate approaches/models, and ensure scalability and integration. Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and translate into practical application.

**5) Adoption, Change & Value Realization:** Drive business adoption of AI solutions, not just delivery. Define metrics and success measures and track realization of expected outcomes. Partner with HR / change / comms teams to support workflow integration and behavior change. Ensure value realization is clearly defined, tracked, and communicated, with a focus on measurable outcomes.

**6) Governance & Responsible AI:** Ensure adherence to enterprise AI governance, risk, and compliance frameworks. Operationalize responsible AI practices (e.g., transparency, fairness, controls). Support approval processes and risk assessments for AI deployments. Ensure alignment to the enterprise AI operating model, embedding best practices across data, technology, risk, talent, and change management.

**7) Matrix Team Leadership:** Lead through influence and build strong execution capability and accountability across a broad cross-functional team. Create consistency in delivery methodologies and standards. Foster a high-performance, results-oriented environment; drive clarity, accountability, and continuous improvement across teams.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* 8–10+ years in AI, data/analytics, digital, or large-scale transformation (preferably experience in strategy consulting)
* Demonstrated success in operating with an enterprise mindset and delivering complex, cross-functional initiatives
* Strong understanding of: AI/ML and GenAI applications, data platforms and enterprise technology environments
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly and influence across technical and business stakeholders to drive alignment and decisions

* Ability to build strong relationships and lead effectively in a matrixed environment without direct authority. Experience aligning stakeholders on priorities, trade-offs, and timelines
* Experience driving execution across multiple stakeholder groups
* Ability to translate strategy into clear, actionable plans and delivered outcomes
* Experience driving adoption and change, ensuring solutions are embedded and delivering business value
* Proven ability to exercise sound judgment, make timely decisions, and navigate ambiguity confidently
* Experience leading large-scale programs or transformation initiatives with clear accountability for outcomes
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to use data to inform decisions and optimize execution

**Preferred**

* Advanced degree (e.g., MBA, Data Science or related field)
* Experience leading enterprise programs
* Financial services or regulated industry experience
* Background balancing technical depth with program leadership
* Familiarity with AI governance and responsible AI frameworks
* Experience in consulting, strategy, or similar roles supporting enterprise transformation initiatives

**In-Office Collaboration**

We are a client-centric, relationship-based business. Working together, in-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face-to-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least three (3) days per week, with flexibility to work from home two (2) days per week. Some roles may require additional in-office time or different in-office expectations, and specific requirements will be discussed during the hiring process.

Full time

(2:00p-10:30p)

AWMPO AWMP&S President's Office

**Job Family Group**

Data

title: Data Science & Data Analytics Trainer

title: Associate Data Scientist
description:
**Key Responsibilities:**

- Client & Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with business clients to understand pain points, translate requirements into technical specifications, and present data-driven recommendations clearly to non-technical audiences.

- Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA): Clean, preprocess, and analyse large structured and unstructured datasets to identify patterns, trends, and anomalies.

- Predictive & Prescriptive Modelling: Design, build, validate, and deploy ML models (e.g., classification, regression, clustering, time-series forecasting, NLP) to solve business challenges.

- Dashboarding & Storytelling: Create clear, impactful visualisations and executive-ready dashboards using BI tools to communicate findings effectively.

- Code Optimisation & Version Control: Write production-quality, reproducible Python/R code, maintaining version control best practices and participating in code reviews.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Data Engineers, Product Managers, and Solution Architects to integrate algorithms into client workflows or production pipelines.

**Technical Expertise:**

- Programming: Advanced proficiency in Python, including libraries like pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, statsmodels, and matplotlib/seaborn.

- Database & SQL: Strong proficiency in writing complex SQL queries to extract, join, and manipulate data from relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, BigQuery).

- Machine Learning: Solid background in supervised and unsupervised learning techniques (e.g., Random Forests, XGBoost, Logistic Regression, K-Means, Decision Trees).

- Data Visualisation: Experience building dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.

- Tools & Environment: Familiarity with Git, Jupyter Notebooks, and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

**Preferred Skills:**

- Familiarity with LLMs, Generative AI APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic), or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications.

- Understanding of ML lifecycle frameworks (MLflow, Airflow) and MLOps fundamentals.

- Domain knowledge in industry verticals such as Retail/E-commerce, Healthcare, Financial Services, or Supply Chain.

**Education:**

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per year

* Flexible schedule
* Provident Fund

title: Associate Manager AI/ML Engineering
description:

Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  

This role communicates and presents complex analytics results and concepts to leadership and internal stakeholders. The role employs AI and/or ML techniques that may include natural language processing (NLP), natural language understanding (NLU), semantic understanding, intent classification, computer vision, deep learning, and automatic speech recognition (ASR).

  

The role works with large\-scale computing frameworks and data analysis systems. The role is expected to apply knowledge of experimental methodologies, statistics, optimization, probability theory, and machine learning using code for tool building and statistical analysis, using both general purpose software and statistical languages.

* Hands\-on, self\-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks with significant focus on infusing AI/ML/Generative AI where applicable
* Possess deep expertise AI/ML/Generative AI, Agile methodologies, and DevSecOps to deliver daily product deployments using full automation from code check\-in to production across the full SDLC/AIDLC lifecycle
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Master's degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline
* 6\+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Data Science, or Analytics, with at least 8 years in AI/ML engineering or related fields and the last 3 years focused on Generative AI technologies including OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, LangChain, Agents, RAG, Vector Databases, Prompt Engineering, and fine\-tuning
* Experience with AI/ML frameworks and tools such as MLFlow, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, and Scikit\-learn
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, and GCP
* Experience with DevOps and CI/CD tools and practices including Git, Jenkins, Docker, and Kubernetes
* Hands\-on experience in AI and driving the development of innovative AI and machine learning solutions

* Proven expertise in AI/ML techniques including deep learning, natural language processing, computer vision, recommender systems, reinforcement learning, and large language models

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Masters/Graduate Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline
* Experience working with cross\-functional and distributed teams in a global and diverse environment
* Experience in establishing and enforcing AI/ML best practices, standards, and ethics
* Experience in Realizing Value from AI/ML products as well as production ready product
* Proven history of delivering high\-impact AI/ML solutions for real\-world problems and use cases

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone.
